description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for centralized logging in an Android project. It provides methods for various log levels and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log output.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging at different levels, managing a chain of LogNode objects for output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode chain to which logs are sent.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain that will handle log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message to the LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at verbose level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at debug level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at info level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message or Throwable at warning level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message or Throwable at error level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message or Throwable at assert level.
